name: awkit-ocr-lab-fonts
description: N7.6 (awkit-vra.9.7) OCR Lab font source. Never bundled into the app: scripts/prepare-ocr-lab-fonts.mjs copies the pinned Noto Sans faces (SIL Open Font License 1.1) into mock-site/public/fonts with their licence and SHA-256 manifest. Installed by the owner only: npm install --prefix mock-site/fonts-src --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
